description: Doc header says 'v0.1 limitation — legacy string types not normalized', grouping BMPString/UniversalString/TeletexString as historical baggage. But then immediately says BMPString/UniversalString *will* be normalized in v0.2, while TeletexString will never be. This contradictory framing confuses users: they read 'legacy' and assume all three are unsupported indefinitely. Support question: 'Why is BMPString legacy if you're adding it in v0.2?' Recommend: reframe as 'currently-unsupported string types: BMPString (planned v0.2), UniversalString (planned v0.2), TeletexString (intentionally not normalized due to vendor incompatibility)'.
title: Framing BMPString/UniversalString as 'legacy' contradicts v0.2 support plan
